name: Iumi ―ORPHAN'S CRADLE―
source:
Yu Oumi is a young man with the ability to see what shouldn't exist. Having lost his mother, his only remaining family, he visits her childhood home to fulfill his final duty.

His stay on Uchinami Island, an island cut off by the tides. His interactions with the fellow passengers on the boat and the islanders gently begin to soothe his heart.

…But the mysteries of the isolated island slowly reach out to him…
